The candidate-submitted maximum screenshot is a Settings sheet at 1.00x rather than a 150% long-metadata hero capture; my fresh 150% capture also displays the runtime error banner.
The normal- and maximum-scale verification bundles contain non-empty long artist/title text in both tree and semantics lenses, independently confirming the overlay renders.
